_note: Settings read by 'gunj date'. confidence_threshold is CALIBRATED on the threshold half of the negative set (PROTOCOL.md section 10; results/threshold.json, written by scripts/set_threshold.py). The v2 (primary extractor) tau of each cell is in confidence_threshold_cells (excerpt minutes -> scope); confidence_threshold is the largest of them. The former placeholder 0.1 is not used for any result.
confidence_threshold_rule: m = floor(0.01 n); tau = (m+1)-th largest threshold-half confidence + 0.0001 (PROTOCOL.md section 10). Trials with no runner-up count in n as no verdict.
confidence_definition: atanh(r1) - atanh(r2): Fisher-z margin of the top candidate over the best candidate peak at least 60 s away
